additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Alexandre,
We have checked the charger on SCB and observed that it is running an outdated version.
We recommend upgrading your charger’s firmware to the latest version. These updates generally include bug fixes, performance enhancements, and improved compatibility with electric vehicle communication protocols, which can help address the errors we’ve been encountering.
Please provide us with a suitable date and time so that we can proceed with initializing the firmware update.
Thank you for your cooperation.
